Factual dispute 1: Q3'25 GAAP EPS was 0.39 (Runs 1-2 cite the 8-K) or 0.26 (Run 3). I side with 0.39; Run 3 likely mixed it up with the 0.26 GAAP consensus figure. It is historical context only and does not affect the Q3'26 build. Factual dispute 2: the SpaceX stake's June 30 value, either the 10-Q carrying value of $3.007B (net of the marketability discount) or ~$158/sh implied by the $2B cost basis. Both give ~-$140M, so it is immaterial. The median spread (0.17-0.21) is a judgment call. My bottom-up build gives ~0.195, and I give the 0.26 GAAP consensus some weight against Tesla's recent misses. I set width from FX/tax volatility, consistent with the runs.
